title: NeuralMind Community Benchmark Entry
description: One row in docs/community-benchmarks.json. Users submit a PR adding an entry to the `entries` array; CI validates against this schema.

schema_version.description: Entry format. 2 — written by `neuralmind benchmark --contribute` from v4.5.0 — adds the ratio against the submitter's measured code (`measured_avg_reduction_ratio`, `full_codebase_tokens`). Entries without it are 1: the fixed-estimate ratio only.

project_name.description: Short, human-readable project name. Keep under 40 chars.

repo_url.description: Public repo URL if the project is open source. Optional — private repos are fine; you just can't link to them.

nodes.description: Total node count reported by `neuralmind stats .`. Integer, > 0.

avg_wakeup_tokens.description: Average tokens returned by `neuralmind wakeup .`. Typical range: 200–800.

avg_query_tokens.description: Average tokens returned by `neuralmind query` across a representative query set.

avg_reduction_ratio.description: Average reduction ratio against the fixed 50,000-token estimate every row of the table compares on: `avg_reduction_ratio` from `neuralmind benchmark . --naive-50k --json` (v4.5.0+), or from `neuralmind benchmark . --json` before v4.5.0. It is 50,000 ÷ tokens per question, so it tracks context size, not repo size. Must be >= 1 (ratio, not percentage).

measured_avg_reduction_ratio.description: v2: the same run against the measured size of the code the index covers — `avg_reduction_ratio` from `neuralmind benchmark . --json` (v4.5.0+). Scales with the repo, and is below 1 on a repo smaller than NeuralMind's context.

full_codebase_tokens.description: v2: the measured baseline — tokens (at ~4 chars/token, the context's own estimate) of every code file the index covers. `full_codebase_tokens` from `neuralmind benchmark . --json` (v4.5.0+).

queries_per_day.description: Typical query volume, used for cost-savings estimation. Optional.

model.description: Which LLM you run NeuralMind against most often. Used for honest cost-savings calculation.

submitted_by.description: GitHub username of the submitter (no leading @).

verification_command.description: The exact command you ran to produce these numbers. Reviewers can re-run it locally to verify — this is what makes the table auditable. To reproduce a v1 entry on v4.5.0+, add --naive-50k.

notes.description: Optional additional context — e.g. 'private monorepo', 'runs on Claude Code with hooks installed', 'includes auto-generated code excluded'. Keep short.
